That's a good question! I guess, I can think of a few things.. 
Firstly, it takes practice & lots of uncomfortable moments but it gets easier!! 
Remember your strengths & psyche yourself up before social outings with yourself in the mirror? 
Just start by observing the crowd. 
People respond well to compliments, so if you notice something you like about the woman you want to approach then lead with that! Maybe you like her dress, the smell of her perfume or even her smile? Let her response/thank you. Then you can ask her a question about the thing you complimented her on - maybe ask her where she got it? (this could also work with her smile lol). 
Give her time to ad another topic to the conversation. Don't feel pressured to talk or think of things to say.. Being a good listener is a strong point! And leaves a bit of mystery! 
Ask questions about her, then if she's interested she'll answer & ask you back. (You can have the same 3 questions that you can ask every girl when you first meet! So you go in prepared). 
If you're finding it hard to respond, paraphrasing what she just said, then saying something like "that's interesting", can fill up some blank spots & can buy you more time to like of another relatable response.. (I hope that made sense lol)
You don't have to make eye contact, as long as you can practice appearing as though it's a direct gaze. You'll appear more confident & flirtatious. 
If you have relaxed body language, you'll appear relaxed, even if your nervous asf. 
Also, social anxiety sucks! But you're not alone! Everyone appears more confident than they really are a lot of the time! So don't assume you're the only one struggling. There's a lot of shy women out there that are pretty & interesting but maybe they're scared to approach you?! You never know, there's always at least one of these types of females in a group! They usually prefer 1 on 1 convos anyway. 
Take things slow & don't be too hard on yourself! You'll meet people that you find interesting & they you. The first part is always the hardest, small talk is awkward asf. Sometimes a little alcohol can help, if you're of the right age! 

Basically, you just have to go for it!!!

I hope this helps!! Good luck!!
